n: 24 Inch 52 Dba Front Control Dishwasher With Lodecibel Operation And Dynamic Dry™
desc: LG's new Front Control Dishwasher, with Dynamic Dry, provides the ultimate drying performance. LG's convenient front control design makes it easier than ever to preview and select the settings you want.
hl: Consumer Reports rated the LG LDFC2423V as a top-contender in washing performance and energy efficiency.SEE REVIEW SUMMARY
Offering top-class cleaning performance at below $500, the LG LDFC2423V was named CR Recommended and the Best Dishwasher for $500 or Less by Consumer Reports.SEE ARTICLE
More Efficient Drying, Less Time Wasted
Drying clean dishes by hand just to be able to unload the dishwasher is a huge time suck—but not anymore.
Auto leak detection instantly stops the cycle if a leak is ever detected for worry-free operation- and dry floors.
Stainless Interior for Lasting Peace of Mind
Unlike tubs made from plastic, the LG Rust-Resistant Stainless Steel Tub is a durable surface.
You Can Use Your Indoor Voice
Now you can run the dishwasher whenever you want—day or night.
